seg.seg_note: Q4-2010 resegmentation: five segments Test & Measurement, Environmental, Life Sciences & Diagnostics, Dental, Industrial Technologies (previously four: Professional Instrumentation, Medical Technologies, Industrial Technologies, Tools & Components). The hand-tools businesses contributed to the Apex Tool Group JV (formed 4-Jul-2010, 50/50 with Cooper Industries) are shown separately: entry 'Businesses contributed to Apex joint venture' = sales attributable to periods prior to contribution 315.6 and OP = 41.5 prior to contribution + 22.8 equity-method earnings subsequent to JV formation (64.3, computed sum of the two published rows). Remaining Tools & Components niche businesses moved to Industrial Technologies. Segment data from 10-K Note 19 ($m, identical to release). Growth components from 10-K MD&A segment tables ('Existing businesses' = core, 'Acquisitions', 'Currency exchange rates'), additive presentation (core + acq + fx = total; acq positive = added growth); '—' recorded as 0.0. Core growth excludes H2-2009 sales of the businesses contributed to Apex. Segment depreciation and amortization only published combined (extra.seg_extra); MD&A shows T&M D&A 107.8 vs 107.7 in Note 19. No restructuring charges in 2010.

item_amounts: Acquisition-related transaction costs deemed significant ($8m pre-tax) and fair value adjustments to acquisition related inventory and deferred revenue balances ($54m pre-tax) ("Acquisition Related Costs")
Gain on contribution of assets to Apex joint venture ("Joint Venture Gain")

ngaap.notes: Adjusted EPS excludes acquisition transaction costs deemed significant (quarterly costs above $13.5m / ~$0.02 per share; ~$35m expected for 2010), acquisition fair value adjustments to inventory and deferred revenue, the Apex JV gain and discrete income tax items. Amortization of intangibles is NOT added back (amort_pretax null). Adjusted net earnings 1,564.4 (2009: 1,177.2). Free cash flow = operating cash flow less purchases of PP&E (no disposal proceeds) - first year the Q4 release carries an FCF table. Release has no numeric 2011 guidance.
